material.text: opencode-models-manager: OpenCode plugin — manage agent models from a single JSON file

type=plugin source=npm:opencode-models-manager created=2026-11-03T16:10:05.845Z firstSeen=2026-11-12T16:45:49.889Z published=2026-11-04T21:00:53.012Z maintainers=rainingdaemons repoId=1444522595 stars=0 npm30d=?

Manage your AI models from a single JSON file.

--- ## Why? This repo was created to provide a simple solution for managing AI models for every chat mode from a single point. The AI industry changes rapidly, so having one place to update models makes it easy to keep every agent current without editing each configuration separately. ## Installation The `main` branch is the OpenCode v1 line and requires OpenCode 1.18.0 or later. It is not compatible with OpenCode v2. ``` opencode plugin opencode-models-manager@0.1.1 ``` For OpenCode v2, use the `v2` branch until the 2.x package release is published. Restart OpenCode after installation. ## Manual installation Add to `~/.config/opencode/opencode.json` (global) or `opencode.json` (project): ```json { "plugin": ["opencode-models-manager@0.1.1"] } ``` ## Local installation Copy `models.ts` into your project plugin directory: ``` .opencode/plugins/models.ts ``` OpenCode loads `.opencode/plugins/` automatically at startup, so no config entry is needed. ## Usage Create `.opencode/models.json` in the project root: ```json { "agent": { "chat": "opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash", "chat2": "opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-flash" }, "commands": { "document": "opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash", "document2": "opencode-go/mimo-v2.6-flash" } } ``` The `agent` section targets agents in `.opencode/agent` and the `commands` section targets commands in `.opencode/commands`. The plugin merges the model into each existing configuration, so prompts, permissions, frontmatter, and other settings are preserved. A flat map such as `{ "chat": "provider/model" }` is still supported and applies to agents. Invalid entries are logged and skipped. Restart OpenCode after changing `models.json` so the config hook runs again. ## OpenCode v2 OpenCode v2 requires a default plugin definition object. The v2 implementation lives on the [`v2`](https://github.com/RainingDaemons/opencode-models-manager/tree/v2) branch and is versioned as `0.2.0`. Use the v2 configuration key (`plugins`, plural): ```json { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugins": ["opencode-models-manager@0.2.0"] } ``` Agent models in `.opencode/models.json` are applied through the agent transform API. Command models are applied by registering command overrides through the v2 add-only command API; the runtime must expose both `ctx.command.transform` and `ctx.session.prompt`.
